headline: PAC Kingston Airport Appoints Héctor Cortés CEO to Lead $161 Million Upgrade
summary: PAC Kingston Airport Limited appointed Héctor Cortés as CEO to manage Norman Manley International Airport's J$25.8 billion ($161 million) infrastructure modernization and transformation project in Jamaica.
why: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico operates major airport concessions in Mexico and Jamaica, making executive transitions central to long-term aviation capital investments.
